AN ORDINANCE AMENDING SECTION 4-301 OF THE CODE OF ORDINANCES OF THE CITY OF MANSFIELD, GEORGIA

Whereas, the City of Mansfield has the responsibility to regulate and prohibit any act, practice, or conduct which is detrimental or likely to be detrimental, to the health, sanitation, cleanliness, welfare and safety of the inhabitants of the City and to provide for the enforcement of such standards; and,

Whereas, the City of Mansfield has the power to make, ordain, and establish such ordinances, rules and regulations as shall appear necessary for the security, welfare, convenience and interest of the City and its inhabitants and for preserving the health, peace, order and good government of the City; and,

Therefore, we, the members of the City Council for the City of Mansfield, Georgia, HEREBY ORDAIN AS FOLLOWS:
